title: Ortarco 8 Inch Stainless Steel Muddler for Cocktails
description:
About this item
NON-SCRATCH NYLON HEAD - This grooved muddler with generous nylon head won’t damage glass. Besides, it is very durable and does not crack or leave residue like the wooden muddlers do
HIGH QUALITY STAINLESS STEEL - This premium muddler is made of the strongest material which is food grade. It's durable and will not rust
EASY TO CLEAN - Once finished using the cocktail muddler, it's easy to clean it by hand or just placing it inside the dishwasher since this muddler is dishwasher safe
BARTENDING FUN: You can crush strawberries, lemons, mints, vanillas, ices to produce perfect mojitos or other cocktails
INDISPENSABLE BARTENDER KIT - Using this cocktail muddler is a great way to create a delicious cocktails. This 8" muddler for bar set is the most basic and essential for a professional bartender or a homemade fan
